page.title: Behaviour Consultation Questionnaire
page.subtitle: Please answer the following questions as precisely as possible.
page.intro: Your answers are an important aid for diagnosing and treating your pet's problem and will of course be treated confidentially.

owner.name: Name, first name
owner.reasonForChoosing: Why did you choose this particular pet?

pet.name: Pet's name
pet.origin: Where does your pet come from?
pet.breederRearing: If from a breeder: describe the keeping and rearing. Did you see the parent animals?
pet.historyBeforeOwner: If you are not the first owner: do you know anything about your pet's past before it came to you?
pet.ageWhenAcquired: How old was your pet when it came to you?
pet.ownedSince: Since when has the pet lived with you?
pet.neuteredAge: At what age was your pet neutered?
pet.neuteringReason: Was there a particular reason for neutering?
pet.behaviorChangesAfterNeutering: Did any behavioural changes occur after neutering? If so, which?
pet.school: Did you attend a dog school or train your pet yourself? Do you use aids such as a clicker?
pet.knownCommands: Which commands does your pet know (e.g. sit, down, leave)?
pet.feeding: What and how often does your pet eat?
pet.supplements: Does your pet receive any food supplements?
pet.digestion: How often does your pet defecate per day? Does it have digestive problems? If so, which symptoms?
pet.lastDeworming: When was your pet last dewormed?
pet.bloodTest: Has a blood test been done recently? Were there any abnormalities?

success.title: Thank you!

form.title: Title *
form.orderHint: Leave empty to append the article at the end.

pageTypeHelp.DEFAULT: Running text with images, as on Privacy and Imprint: the content is spread around the images, sections follow below. Not shown on block-based pages (e.g. Home).
pageTypeHelp.HERO: Title = heading, content = subline, tags = label above the heading, 1st image = image next to the text.
pageTypeHelp.COL2: Title = heading, content = intro, sections = text blocks, 1st image = image next to the text.
pageTypeHelp.COL3: Title and content = header, each section = one of three columns.
pageTypeHelp.COL4: Title and content = header, each section = one of four columns.
pageTypeHelp.TEXT: Title = heading, content = intro, sections = text blocks below.
pageTypeHelp.HERO_PORTRAIT: Title = heading, content = subline, 1st section = first-person statement, 1st image = portrait.
pageTypeHelp.SYMPTOMS: Title = heading, content = intro, each section = one complaint (title + one sentence).
pageTypeHelp.METHODS: Title = heading, content = intro, each section = one focus area with its own image (choose it in the section).
pageTypeHelp.STEPS: Title = heading, content = intro, each section = one step, ordered with the arrows.
pageTypeHelp.VET_BAND: Title = question, content = sentence below; the button leads to "For vets".
pageTypeHelp.NEWS_TEASER: Entry in the list on "News": title and excerpt of the content (else of the 1st section).
pageTypeHelp.NEWS_PAGE: Entry in the list on "News": title and excerpt of the content (else of the 1st section).
pageTypeHelp.ABOUT_TEASER: Title = heading, content = text, sections = qualifications line, 1st image = photo; links to "About me".
